title: limit13: passive limit-order entries on the live signal types vs market entry (queue v2 item 13)
before_registration: No outcome of any limit variant was computed before this file. `check` ran synthetic fixtures and a parity test of manage() vs labels_v2.simulate on WTI market entries (equality only, no statistics). Known before: notrade12 results (spread-filtered sets average about -0.12 R).

evaluator.note: labels_v2.simulate (market baseline), fills.resolve, validate.day_boot unchanged; manage() = simulate with entry bar/price/first bar as parameters, parity-checked

data: engine/cache M1 bid/ask npz via nt12.load_m1c, cut 2026-10-07T18:30 UTC; M5/M15/H1 by bars.resample; production supertrend

signals.types: supertrend flips and volume impulses (nt12 definitions) on M5 and M15
signals.filters: passing no-trade filters of notrade12: spread (ask_c-bid_c)/(1.5 ATR) at the signal bar <= 0.2 AND entry hour (signal close, UTC) not in the instrument's 4 thin hours (nt12.thin_hours, 2018-2022 spread only)
signals.guard: signals in the last 4 days before the cut dropped; a signal is dropped from ALL arms when the market or any limit/null outcome is censored (paired sample)

baseline: market entry at the open of the next bar on ask (buy) / bid (sell), labels_v2.simulate POLICY (308 baseline: k=1.5, stop -1R, breakeven after +1R with one-bar latency, 3R target, opposite flip exits, H=72 bars)

variant_rules.placement: order placed at the signal bar close. ref: buy limit at bid_c - d*ATR_tf, sell limit at ask_c + d*ATR_tf (d=0: join the bid/ask). st: the supertrend line at the signal bar. vwap: session VWAP (22:00 UTC day, M1 mid typical price x tick volume) at the signal close. A level on the marketable side is capped at the bid (buy) / ask (sell)
variant_rules.life: live for TF bars k+1..k+expiry; cancelled after the close of the first opposite same-timeframe flip in that window
variant_rules.fill: conservative: buy fills in the first M1 bar whose ASK low < limit (sell: BID high > limit), at the limit price (no price improvement on gaps). optimistic bound: touch (<=, >=) + optimistic management
variant_rules.management: 308 baseline in R of the original stop distance (R = 1.5 ATR at the signal bar), stop/arm/target from the fill price; management bar 0 = the remaining M1 minutes of the fill bar after the fill minute; H=72 TF bars counted from the fill bar; conservative: a fill-minute exit-side low at or through the stop exits at the stop

family: primary: M5 + M15, all 6 instruments, flips + impulses pooled, signal-weighted. Breakdowns by TF x kind (4 signal families) and by stream (24) are exploratory
objective: net R per signal (unfilled = 0) and per filled trade, vs (i) market entry on the same signals, (ii) random thinning of market entries at the fill rate (fill_rate x market mean; and the filled subset's market mean vs 500 random subsets of the same size), (iii) a random-timing limit null: same variant, side, distance rule and expiry placed at a random TF bar in the same UTC clock hour of the same day (20 draws, mean)
adverse_selection: market-entry R of filled vs unfilled signals (mkt_f - mkt_all), and the execution difference on filled signals (limit R - market R)
statistics: 5-day moving-block day bootstrap (validate.day_boot, 1000 reps primary, 500 per family); one-sided bootstrap p; Holm across the 8 variants per test
decision_rule: CANDIDATE (for shadow registration consideration, never 'qualified') iff (a) dev 2018-2022 Holm p < 0.05 for per-filled-trade mean net R > 0, (b) dev Holm p < 0.05 for d_thin = net R per signal - fill_rate x market mean > 0 AND dev 95% CI of d_null (minus random-timing null) above 0, (c) 2023+ development window: per-filled mean > 0, d_thin > 0 and d_null > 0. IMPROVES_EXECUTION_ONLY iff (b) and the 2023+ part of (c) on d_thin/d_null hold but (a) fails. Else FAIL. Conservative fills and management decide; touch/optimistic reported as an upper bound
rules: no test_ledger; nothing marked qualified; development evidence only; trials logged with exp limit13

amendments.kind: post-hoc, after run 1, reporting only (no decision rule, variant or metric changed)
amendments.reason: registered random-timing null drew bars anywhere in the signal clock hour incl. bars BEFORE the signal with the signal side = look-ahead (null_ps about +0.15 R). Added two lookahead-free nulls via nullfix13.py (lim13.py unchanged): after (random bar at/after the signal in its hour) and otherday (same clock time, random other day +-1..20, same side). Outputs out_null_after/, out_null_otherday/. Verdicts unchanged (criterion a fails for every variant).
